props.heading: Questions, answered

items.question: How long does setup take?
items.answer: Most teams connect their tools and see their first dashboard within an hour.

items.question: Can I cancel anytime?
items.answer: Yes. Plans are month to month and you can cancel from your account settings.

items.question: Do you offer discounts for nonprofits?
items.answer: Yes, registered nonprofits get 50% off any plan. Contact us to apply.
